about: A flight under way past a fuel stop (the engine's in_flight): the hop flown (0 the first, one more past each fuel stop in refuel_at, an index into the planner's totals' hops), the legs' burn since that hop began (hop_burnt_gal, what strip_fuel takes off the hop's own fuel required), the nav log's leg flown, and the fuel the plan leaves (fuel_now_gal: from the start's 40 gal, or past the stop from the tanks filled to 38, less 1 gal to start and taxi each time). East along the equator, a degree each leg: 60.108 nm on the WGS-84 ellipsoid (pyproj's Geod(ellps="WGS84"): 111,319.49 m), legs of 6, 8 and 5 gal, each burnt evenly over its miles. Planning figures from the nav log, never the airplane's gauge. Figures to within 0.01. iOS: InFlight (the strip's fuel). Android: the strip's fuel.

cases.name: halfway along the first leg, before the stop
halfway along the second leg, past the fuel stop at B
a quarter along the third leg, the second hop's burn counted from B
no fuel stop: one hop, the first tank
